{{Quote|But she is believed to have been present at some of the events that culminated in the Mapuzo break-in, and the Task Force on Alliance Security would like to question her regarding the matter.|A [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Task Force on Alliance Security]] [[SecuriDex]] [[Datafile/Legends|datafile]] on [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Vadon Lenitor]]|<ref name="AIR">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref>}}
'''Mapuzo''' was a [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="Kenobi">{{SW|url=obi-wan-kenobi-part-iii-trivia-gallery|text=Part III Trivia Gallery &#124; Obi-Wan Kenobi}} {{C|Slide 1}}</ref> located in the [[Mapuzo system/Legends|Mapuzo system]] in the [[Hollan sector/Legends|Hollan sector]],<ref name="TEA" /> which lay in the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion<ref name="Atlas" /> of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="TEA" /> Via a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]], Mapuzo was connected to the [[Nicandra system/Legends|Nicandra system]] in the [[Nicandra sector/Legends|Nicandra sector]] and the [[Walin'or system/Legends|Walin'or system]] in the [[Shiwal sector/Legends|Shiwal sector]].<ref name="Warfare" />

Mapuzo<ref name="Kenobi" /> was the site of the [[Mapuzo break-in]], which occurred<ref name="AIR" /> [[Time/Legends|sometime]] by [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]'' represents a collection of [[in-universe]] reports from "one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] before the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]," which corresponds to [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> In [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], during the [[Orinda campaign]] by the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]], Mapuzo lay within the territory of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="Warfare" />

==Behind the scenes==
The [[1995]] [[West End Games]] ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' sourcebook ''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]'' featured a mention of the Mapuzo break-in,<ref name="AIR" /> after which the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]] established the existence of the Mapuzo [[Star system/Legends|system]] in grid square M-7<ref name="Atlas" /> and the [[2012]] book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by Fry and [[Paul R. Urquhart]] depicted the system on a [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] map.<ref name="Warfare" />

On [[June 1]], [[2022]],<ref name="D23">{{D23|url=everything-new-you-can-stream-on-disney-in-june-2022|text=Everything New You Can Stream on Disney+ in June 2022}}</ref> "[[Part III]]," the third episode of the [[Disney+]] series [[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi|''Obi-Wan Kenobi'']], introduced the [[planet]] [[Mapuzo]] into the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]].<ref name="Part III">{{Kenobi|Part III}}</ref> The corresponding episode guide on [[StarWars.com]] confirmed that in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, Mapuzo had been a world that had originally been mentioned in ''Alliance Intelligence Reports''.<ref name="Kenobi" />
